notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Thanks to all who noticed errors in the game. We fixed them!

- Achievement now works (unite monsters to get)
- Fixed a bug with the balance of the game.
- The game has a new game (if you are caught in a bug when the game is released, this button will help you)
- Added ending in the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430861/e5b27436e732ac0bf8b7d2c82237a685234b0ba1.gif[/img]
